title: vcpkg manifest with no version constraints
description: vcpkg.json declares a manifest that accepts whatever version the baseline resolves. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a manifest that accepts whatever version the baseline resolves.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a manifest that accepts whatever version the baseline resolves.
limitation: It matches a manifest that accepts whatever version the baseline resolves in the parsed vcpkg.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
